newsitem.title: USA: Zycad needs more shares for conversion.
newsitem.headline: Zycad needs more shares for conversion.

text.p: Zycad Corp said Thursday it will hold a special shareholder meeting to increase its common stock in order to avoid default under convertible preferred stock agreements.

The company said shares reserved for debt financing and convertible preferred stock offering have exhausted its authorized common stock and are inadequate to meet conversion requirements at Thursday's stock price.
Zycad shares closed Thursday unchanged at 27/32.
It said it needs the additional shares for conversion of convertible preferred stock and accompanying stock warrants from a recent $5 million private placement.

The company said it has about 1.6 million shares reserved for the balance of $1.2 million outstanding of a $10 million debenture financing from May 1996 and about six million shares reserved for the $5 million convertible preferred stock offering and accompanying stock warrants.

"While we regret having to take this action, it is absolutely necessary to avoid a possible conversion deficiency and default under the convertible preferred stock agreements," the company statement said.
The company said it will hold the special meeting on or about June 10 in order to raise its common shares to 50 million shares from 40 million.

The company said it is seeking to issue more than than 20 percent of the outstanding shares of common stock to holders of its convertible preferred stock Series A-1 to A-5 upon conversion of the Preferred Stock and accompanying stock warrants.
